known_differences.description: fsci-fft uses mixed-radix Cooley-Tukey (radices 2/3/4/5/7/11/13/17), Rader, and Bluestein chirp-z transforms with a thread-safe plan cache.

threats.description: NaN or Inf values in complex or real input slices propagate across all frequency bins during butterfly stages.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-fft/src/transforms.rs:2235 (fft): scans input for non-finite values when check_finite or Hardened mode is active and returns FftError::NonFiniteInput.
threats.strict_mode_response: Check finiteness when FftOptions::check_finite is enabled.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Always check finiteness and emit AuditAction::FailClosed on NaN/Inf.

threats.description: Large prime-length transforms could degrade to O(n^2) without Bluestein chirp-z factorization.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-fft/src/transforms.rs:2235 (fft): dispatches composite lengths to mixed-radix butterflies and large primes (> 61) to O(n log n) Bluestein / Rader transforms.
threats.strict_mode_response: Execute mixed-radix or Bluestein O(n log n) plan matching PocketFFT.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Same O(n log n) dispatch with input finiteness and shape validation.

threats.description: Zero, negative, or non-finite sample spacing d in fftfreq / rfftfreq causes division by zero.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-fft/src/helpers.rs:6 (fftfreq): validates sample_spacing > 0.0 and finite before computing frequency bins.

threats.description: Empty input arrays or invalid normalization / axis specifications drifting from SciPy fft conventions.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-fft/src/transforms.rs:2250 (ifft): rejects zero-length transform inputs with FftError::InvalidShape and applies exact Backward/Ortho/Forward scaling.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(FftError::InvalidShape) on empty input matching SciPy ValueError.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject fail-closed and record AuditAction::FailClosed in AuditLedger.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Reject when check_finite flag is set.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject unconditionally with FftError::NonFiniteInput and FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: empty input array or zero transform length
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return FftError::InvalidShape and log FailClosed event.
Return FftError::InvalidAxis and log FailClosed event.
